we use CLIP, a multimodal model with zero-shot image classification capabilities, to predict gender (note that Stable Diffusion also uses CLIP's text encoder to encode prompts). We perform gender classification by computing the cosine similarity between CLIP embeddings: cos(CLIP(image), CLIP(a photo of a woman)) as well as cos(CLIP(image), CLIP(a photo of a man)).
